name: Canva
summary: An online design tool with templates for social posts, posters, presentations and more.
description: Canva is an online design tool built around a drag-and-drop editor and a large template library. You pick a design type (a social media post, poster, presentation and so on), start from a template or a blank page, and add text, photos and graphics. The Free plan covers a lot of everyday design work; paid plans add premium templates and media, more brand kits, scheduling and more AI tools. Eligible nonprofits can apply for free premium access.

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan: drag-and-drop editor with 1,000+ design types, 1.6M+ templates, 4.7M+ photos, videos, graphics and audio, 1 Brand Kit (3 colours only), 5GB cloud storage and up to 20 Standard or Premium AI uses (as listed on the official pricing page).
pricing.paid_plan_summary: Pro adds premium templates and media, 5 Brand Kits, social content scheduling and AI tools such as resize, translate and background removal. A Business plan is also listed. K-12 education and eligible nonprofits have separate free programmes; check eligibility on Canva's site.

key_capabilities.text: Drag-and-drop editor with 1,000+ design types and a large template library on the Free plan.
Designs can be made available offline (Canva Offline).

limitations.text: The Free plan includes a limited number of AI uses (up to 20) and 5GB of cloud storage.
Background removal is listed as a Pro feature, not part of the Free plan.
Platform availability (web, mobile, desktop apps) still needs verification from an official source.

best_for: Quick, good-looking social posts, flyers and presentations without design training
Small businesses and nonprofits keeping a consistent look
not_ideal_for: Print work that needs professional pre-press control
People who need fully offline desktop software
getting_started: Open Canva and choose the design type that matches your goal (for example, an Instagram post).
Start from a template and replace the text and images with your own.
Download or share the design and check it on the device where people will see it.
